evidence: Carries RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies JSON-RPC request parsing and HTTP response handling in src/httprpc.cpp and src/rpc/request.cpp.
rationale: Fixes JSON-RPC 2.0 spec noncompliance where malformed requests returned HTTP 400 instead of HTTP 200 error responses and invalid requests without an id were silently dropped as notifications. In addition, it fixes a failing Assume() check that aborted bitcoind in debug builds on malformed JSON-RPC 2.0 requests.
